no_adcom_quote.quote: The NDA for this new molecular entity was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because the application did not raise significant efficacy or safety issues for the proposed indication.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for Zykadia (ceritinib) NDA205755. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and the Division Director memo both state the NDA was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because it did not raise significant or controversial efficacy or safety issues. Instead, two Special Government Employees (an NCI physician and a patient lung-cancer survivor) were consulted individually by teleconference on March 27, 2014; both found the benefit-risk favorable despite concern about gastrointestinal toxicity, but this was not a formal advisory committee meeting and the review documents do not tie it to any specific change in the approval.
